@@ U01 alias-less derived table in own FROM reading target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = prev FROM (SELECT x.repo_id AS rid, x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x) WHERE rid = r.repo_id + 1
@@ U02 alias-less derived in INSERT source, EXCLUDED
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) SELECT rid, prev FROM (SELECT $1::int AS rid, x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.repo_id = $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar
@@ U03 alias-less derived in scalar sub of value
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT prev FROM (SELECT x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.repo_id = $1))
@@ U04 control: aliased
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = s.prev FROM (SELECT x.repo_id AS rid, x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x) s WHERE s.rid = r.repo_id + 1
@@ U05 alias-less with star
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::int, x.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.repo_id = $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar
@@ U06 alias-less derived, other policy fill from other row
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, prev) FROM (SELECT x.repo_id AS rid, x.fe AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x) WHERE rid = r.repo_id + 1
@@ U07 alias-less in CTE
WITH c AS (SELECT rid, prev FROM (SELECT x.repo_id AS rid, x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x)) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = c.prev FROM c WHERE c.rid = r.repo_id + 1
@@ U08 alias-less LATERAL sub w/ sibling clean
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = prev FROM aveloxis_data.other o, LATERAL (SELECT x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.repo_id = o.id) WHERE o.id = r.repo_id
@@ U09 alias-less VALUES
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = column2 FROM (VALUES ($1::int, $2::text)) WHERE column1 = r.repo_id
@@ U10 alias-less in MERGE source
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING (SELECT x.repo_id AS rid, x.ar AS prev FROM aveloxis_data.repos x) ON rid = t.repo_id + 1 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ar = prev
@@ U11 alias-less join parenthesized (no alias) reading target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = o.v FROM (aveloxis_data.other o JOIN aveloxis_data.repos x ON x.repo_id = o.id) WHERE o.id = r.repo_id
@@ U12 alias-less TABLESAMPLE / ONLY
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = x.ar FROM ONLY aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.repo_id = r.repo_id + 1
@@ U13 JSON_TABLE no alias reading target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = v FROM JSON_TABLE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x.ar) FROM aveloxis_data.repos x), '$[*]' COLUMNS (v text PATH '$'))
@@ U14 dedup-style house form, alias-less (real: move loser rows)
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar, fe) SELECT $2, ar, fe FROM (SELECT l.ar, l.fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos l WHERE l.repo_id = $1) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar
